contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($2003.75) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own handwritten 'Subtotal for this page' (2003.75) and its 'Total Contributions Received' (2003.75), and is restated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 20.00 + 200.00 + 1,783.75 = 2,003.75 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 2,003.75 and is NOT summed as an increment — this is the filer's first report of the cycle (line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a typed 0), so period and year-to-date coincide. The balance ladder closes: 0 (line 3) + 2,003.75 (line 4) = 2,003.75 (line 5); 2,003.75 - 2,003.75 (line 6) = 0 (line 7). The candidate's own 1,783.75 loan is INSIDE this total because the filer put it on Schedule A and his own subtotal counts it; nothing was reclassified.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($2003.75) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own handwritten 'Subtotal for this page' (2003.75) and its 'Total Expenditures Received' (2003.75), and restated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 11 Schedule B rows sum to 51.08 + 25.41 + 47.00 + 317.53 + 7.68 + 4.80 + 103.51 + 754.41 + 128.87 + 90.00 + 473.46 = 2,003.75 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A = line 6. Column B YTD prints the same 2,003.75 (first report of the cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. The two sides being equal to the cent is the filer's own design: he loaned the campaign exactly the shortfall (1,783.75) needed to spend out to a zero closing balance.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — neither Schedule A nor Schedule B on this legacy_colAB blank prints an in-kind column, no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind or 'non-monetary', and the p2 Summary Page carries no separate in-kind line. BOTH conventions were tested rather than inherited: monetary-only gives 2,003.75 on each side and monetary-plus-in-kind gives the identical 2,003.75, so both close on Column A. The one annotated row, 'Rod Campbell (personal loan)', is a candidate LOAN and not an in-kind gift, and it sits inside the filer's own printed subtotal.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate name 'Rodney D. Campbell' (Republican, residence city Provo); index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office). Page-face Office Seeking reads 'County Recorder', agreeing with index.csv. legacy_colAB, 4 pages, all four read full-page at 200 dpi: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by CONTENT; foliated 'Page 1 of 1' — see below), p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. ⚠ A SOURCE PROPERTY WORTH RECORDING: THIS FILING IS A TYPED RE-CREATION OF THE COUNTY FORM, NOT THE COUNTY'S OWN BLANK FILLED IN. Every field is machine text — the identity block, the report-type list, the schedule entries and even the Summary Page figures — and only the four schedule subtotal/total cells and the signature are handwritten. Two consequences show on the page: the report-type CHECKBOXES ARE ABSENT ENTIRELY (the five options are printed as bare lines with no boxes, and NONE is marked, so the report type is an honest BLANK — the 2026-08-01 cover tranche recorded it as unreadable and that stands), and the amendment question is answered by a typed 'No X' rather than a tick. The signature date is handwritten '6/14/2010' and the clerk stamped it JUN 14 PM 4:36. FOLIATION: every sheet is foliated 'Page 1 of 1' — the filer numbered each sheet as its own document rather than the filing as a whole, a third variant of the ADDENDUM A4 foliation finding (Poulson numbers '1 of 1' then '1/2/3 of 3'; Barratt foliates nothing in June and 1-5 of 5 in October). A page ordinal remains worthless for locating the summary page. The two sides are EQUAL TO THE CENT (2,003.75 each) and that is the filer's own arithmetic, not a transcription artefact: he loaned his campaign exactly the shortfall needed to spend out to a zero closing balance. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this era in the clear, so donor and vendor street lines are plainly visible on pp3-4 and were reduced to city/state at READ TIME for contributions and DROPPED ENTIRELY for expenditures; none reaches any field or note.
